zh: 修复对话顶栏「···」更多操作菜单：窗口或侧栏收窄后再拉宽时，按钮现在会自动恢复显示（之前会一直收在「···」里直到刷新）；收起时机改为按标题保底宽度判断，标题不再被挤得过窄；管理员的「终端」入口也会出现在「···」菜单中。
en: Fixed the chat header "···" more-actions menu: buttons now come back automatically when the window or sidebar is widened again (previously they stayed collapsed until reload); collapsing is based on a minimum title width so the title is no longer squeezed too far; the Terminal entry for admins now appears in the menu.
